title: Director, Architecture
description:
**Description**
Director, Architecture
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Job Summary**
TheDirectorCloud Architectureserves as the enterprise cloud design authority, owning architecture decisions, standards, and guardrails across all cloud environments to ensure resiliency, security, and scale by design. This role defines cloud architecture strategy and referencearchitecture;establishesavailability, dependency, resiliency, and disaster recovery patterns upfront; and translates architectural intent into enforceable guardrails through policy as code. Partnering closely with Engineering and Infrastructure, the Principal Engineer reviews and shapes platform designs, drives consistent architecture governance, and enables delivery teams to build compliant, repeatable solutions through clear standards and approved patterns.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Own cloud architecture strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards across Azure/AWS/GCP/OCIand hybrid environments, with strong PaaS patterns and guidance.
* Define resiliency, disaster recovery, security, availability, and dependency patterns upfront (including target SLAs/SLOs) and socialize them through clear design artifacts.
* Translate architectural intent into enforceable guardrails, includingpolicy ascode, blueprinting, and paved-road patterns that reduce variation and rework.
* Review and shape platform and product designs in partnership with Engineering and Infrastructure, ensuring alignment to standards and documented risk tradeoffs.
* Establish and run consistent architecture governance (design reviews, decision records, exception process, and lifecycle updates to standards).
* Lead dependency modeling and risk assessments for critical services, driving pragmatic recommendations that balance resiliency, cost, performance, and delivery timelines.
* Define cloud landing-zone and platform guardrails (networking, identity, encryption, logging/monitoring) and ensure they are adoptable by delivery teams.
* Influence through standards: coach teams, create reusable templates and reference implementations, and drive alignment without becoming a delivery bottleneck.

  
  
**Additional Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience); advanced degree preferred.
* Deep multi-cloud architecture experience (Azure,AWS, GCPand OCI), including strong PaaS exposure and experience designing secure, scalable platform patterns.
* Demonstrated credibility as a design authority across engineering and operations teams, witha track recordof driving adoption of standards and reference architectures.
* Strong grasp of resiliency engineering, disaster recovery, availability patterns, dependency modeling, and risk tradeoffs (cost/performance/reliability).
* Hands-on experience translating architecture into enforceable guardrails (policy as code, landing zone controls, standardized pipelines/templates, and exception management).
* Strong security architecture fundamentals (identity, network segmentation, encryption, logging/monitoring) and familiarity with regulated/audit-driven environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability toinfluence throughstandards, coach teams, and align stakeholders on architectural decisions.

**Years of experience:**
10-12 years of experience
  
  
**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
The Director Cloud Architecture serves as the enterprise cloud design authority, owning architecture decisions, standards, and guardrails across all cloud environments to ensure resiliency, security, and scale by design. This role defines cloud architecture strategy and reference architecture; establishes availability, dependency, resiliency, and disaster recovery patterns upfront; and translates architectural intent into enforceable guardrails through policy as code. Partnering closely with Engineering and Infrastructure, the Principal Engineer reviews and shapes platform designs, drives consistent architecture governance, and enables delivery teams to build compliant, repeatable solutions through clear standards and approved patterns.

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Job Description: Cloud Security Architect & Lead**
Role Summary
  
  
The Cloud Security Architect & Lead will own the security architecture, governance, compliance, and operational security posture across Minfy's multi-cloud environments spanning AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This leadership role is responsible for establishing security standards, driving cloud security transformation initiatives, enabling DevSecOps practices, and ensuring secure, compliant, and resilient cloud operations for both Minfy-managed and customer-managed environments.
  
  
The individual will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, FinOps, Product Engineering, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and Strategic Account teams to embed security into every aspect of cloud service delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Multi-Cloud Security Architecture
  
  

+ Define and maintain enterprise cloud security architecture standards across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Develop secure landing zones, reference architectures, and cloud security guardrails.
+ Establish architecture patterns for:
+ Multi-cloud deployments
+ Hybrid cloud environments
+ SaaS platforms
+ AI/ML workloads
+ Kubernetes platforms
+ Review and approve security designs for new cloud initiatives and customer engagements.
+ Drive Zero Trust Architecture adoption across all cloud platforms.

Cloud Security Engineering & DevSecOps
  
  

+ Embed security controls into CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines.
+ Implement Security-as-Code and Policy-as-Code frameworks.
+ Automate compliance validation and security posture assessments.
+ Establish secure software supply chain controls.
+ Drive secure container, Kubernetes, and serverless security practices.
+ Integrate automated vulnerability and misconfiguration detection into engineering workflows.

Security Operations & Threat Management
  
  

+ Define and oversee cloud security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities.
+ Establish multi-cloud threat detection strategies.
+ Lead security incident response and forensic investigations.
+ Drive vulnerability management programs across cloud platforms.
+ Implement cloud-native threat intelligence and proactive threat hunting capabilities.
+ Develop operational runbooks and security response automation.

Governance, Risk & Compliance
  
  

+ Develop cloud security governance frameworks and policies.
+ Establish cloud risk management and control assessment processes.
+ Lead compliance initiatives including:
+ ISO 27001
+ SOC 2
+ PCI DSS
+ GDPR
+ HIPAA
+ NIST CSF
+ CIS Benchmarks
+ Support customer security reviews and regulatory audits.
+ Build continuous compliance monitoring capabilities.

Identity, Access & Data Security
  
  

+ Define enterprise IAM strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Implement Zero Trust and least-privilege access models.
+ Standardize:
+ MFA
+ SSO
+ Federated Identity
+ Privileged Access Management
+ Lead secrets management and encryption strategy.
+ Define enterprise data classification and protection controls.

AI & Emerging Security
  
  

+ Secure GenAI and AI/ML platforms deployed in cloud environments.
+ Establish governance controls for AI workloads.
+ Define security standards for LLM deployments and AI-assisted operations.
+ Assess risks associated with AI services and third-party integrations.
+ Collaborate with AI engineering teams to implement secure AI architectures.

Leadership & Organizational Responsibilities
  
  

+ Build and lead a Cloud Security Center of Excellence within SRE.
+ Mentor Cloud Security Engineers and Security Analysts.
+ Partner with Strategic Account Directors, TAMs, Cloud Architects, and Delivery Leaders.
+ Provide executive-level reporting on security posture, risks, and remediation plans.
+ Support customer-facing security discussions and solution reviews.

**Required Qualifications**




+ 12–15+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, or SRE domains.
+ Minimum 7+ years of cloud security experience.
+ Minimum 3+ years leading cloud security teams or programs.
+ Hands-on expertise across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Strong understanding of:
+ Cloud-native architectures
+ Kubernetes
+ DevSecOps
+ Identity Security
+ Compliance frameworks
+ Security Operations
+ Experience supporting enterprise-scale SaaS environments.
+ Strong customer-facing and consulting capabilities.

**Preferred Certifications**




+ AWS Certified Security – Specialty
+ AWS Solutions Architect Professional
+ Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
+ Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
+ CISSP
+ CCSP
+ CISM
+ CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist)

Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

+ Reduction in critical cloud security findings.
+ Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) score improvement.
+ Compliance audit pass rates.
+ Security incident reduction.
+ MTTD and MTTR improvements.
+ Percentage of infrastructure compliant by default.
+ Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence.
+ Customer security audit success rate.
+ Security automation coverage across cloud platforms.

Reporting Structure
  
  
Reports To: Delivery Leader
  
  
**Manages:**
Cloud Security Engineers, Security Analysts, DevSecOps Engineers, Security Compliance Specialists
  
  
This role becomes the
**security pillar leader within the SRE organization**
, alongside leaders for Cloud Operations, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Observability, and Automation, ensuring secure and compliant operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP customer environments.

title: Engineer Specialist III - Cloud
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing…**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Centralized Operations team. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on professional in the applications operations with a strong background in cloud-native technologies, automation, and the telecom domain. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of our robust and scalable infrastructure, directly contributing to the reliability of our next-generation telecom services. This role requires an autonomous professional who can handle multiple tools and technologies in a fast-paced, DevOps-centric environment.
  
  

* Designing, deploying, and managing scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant infrastructure across Kubernetes and OpenStack environments.
* Developing, executing, and maintaining robust Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation scripts using Ansible, Python, and Shell to automate provisioning and system configurations.
* Administering and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using GitLab to enable seamless software delivery, deployment agility, and rapid operational workflows.
* Configuring and managing core IP networking services, including VPCs, VPNs, SDNs, DNS, load balancers, and firewalls.
* Building, packaging, and deploying microservices and application solutions utilizing containerization technologies like Docker.
* Operating and administering enterprise operational suites, including the VSOP toolchain, DML, and SON applications.
* Building, executing, and managing RPA (Robotic Process Automation) regression testing frameworks, as well as reporting, analyzing, and resolving operational defects.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to continuously safeguard security, optimize operational performance, and enforce cloud governance.

**Where you’ll be working**
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
You’ll need to have:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or four or more years of equivalent work experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenStack, Docker, and other OS virtualization and containerization technologies.
* Expertise in scripting and coding, specifically Ansible, Python, and shell.
* Sound knowledge of the Telecom Domain, including 4G/5G, Network Function Virtualization (NFV), MANO, and SOL standards.
* Strong knowledge of IP Networking, including VPC, VPN, SDN, DNS, and firewalls.
* Proven experience with CI/CD methodologies and tools, particularly gitlab.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and optimize database and storage solutions.:
* Experience with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and configuration management tools like Ansible, postman,
* Familiarity with the day-to-day operational use of centralized tools like the VSOP tool chain, DML, and SON Applications.

Even Better if you have one or more of the following:
  
  

* A Master’s degree

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

title: SVP, Cloud & Infrastructure Platforms
description:
Grade / Level: 15
  
  
**Company Overview**
Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
This role will be a part of the CoreTech organization, which is responsible for cloud, infrastructure, platform operations, reliability engineering, observability, resilience, workplace technology, and technology governance. CoreTech enables Synchrony's application and product teams by delivering secure, scalable, highly available platforms and operational capabilities that support business growth and digital transformation.
  
  
**Role Summary / Purpose**
The Senior Vice President, Cloud & Infrastructure Platforms is responsible for defining and executing the strategy, architecture, engineering practices, transformation initiatives, governance, and operations for Synchrony's private and public cloud platforms. This executive will lead the modernization of enterprise technology capabilities across cloud, networking, platform services, databases, virtual desktop infrastructure, and hybrid-cloud connectivity.
  
  
This role will build and lead a high-performing technology engineering organization focused on delivering secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective platforms that accelerate business growth, enable digital transformation, and strengthen enterprise resilience.
  
  
The SVP will serve as the executive leader for Cloud & Infrastructure Platforms and partner closely with leaders across the CIO, Engineering, Security, Architecture, Product, and Business organizations. The role will establish strategic direction, lead critical technology initiatives, advance Synchrony's cloud-first strategy, and champion engineering excellence through automation, Agile delivery, infrastructure as code, platform standardization, and strong operational discipline.
  
  
This is a highly visible executive leadership role requiring exceptional strategic thinking, execution, organizational leadership, and executive-level communication skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the enterprise strategy, architecture, roadmap, and operating model for private and public cloud, enterprise networking, database platforms, virtual desktop infrastructure, and related platform services.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology engineering organization grounded in accountability, innovation, operational rigor, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with leaders across Technology, Security, Risk, Compliance, Architecture, Product, and Business organizations to align platform investments and priorities with enterprise objectives.
* Lead cloud and infrastructure modernization initiatives that improve agility, resilience, scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency while advancing Synchrony's cloud-first strategy and application modernization objectives.
* Deliver secure, reliable, and scalable cloud, network, database, hybrid-connectivity, and virtual desktop capabilities that support employees, contractors, contact centers, business-critical applications, and Synchrony locations.
* Provide streamlined cloud onboarding, account provisioning, governance, and lifecycle management across supported cloud providers.
* Establish and enforce architecture, engineering, security, and operational standards that advance automation, observability, auditability, infrastructure as code, continuous delivery, platform reliability, service resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Establish governance, controls, and requirements traceability that meet regulatory, audit, risk, security, and policy requirements; represent the organization in regulatory examinations and meetings with agencies including the Federal Reserve Board and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.
* Establish and mature FinOps practices while managing technology budgets, investment priorities, strategic vendors, and resource allocation to optimize cost and deliver measurable business value.
* Develop and execute communication strategies for Technology & Operations leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, the Executive Leadership Team, customers, and external partners; build relationships that align priorities and influence outcomes.
* Serve as an executive advocate for platform modernization, engineering excellence, and technology transformation, and perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelors in computer science, engineering, or related discipline with 10 years of Information Technology leadership experience in lieu of a the Bachelor's degree minimum of 15+ year’s experience in information technology
* Proven track record as a strategic Information Technology business partner to senior leadership, with experience leading large, mission-critical technology platforms and teams.
* Demonstrated success building and operating complex, sophisticated, business-critical technology platforms.
* Strong technical knowledge of cloud, automation, observability, networking, database platforms, and technology operations.
* Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity, establish direction, influence stakeholders, and help teams resolve conflicts.
* Deep domain expertise in the use of cloud, networking, and data technologies to support business strategy and growth.
* Significant experience with major public cloud platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Azure.
* Demonstrated experience presenting technology strategy, operational performance, risk posture, and remediation plans to regulatory agencies, including the Federal Reserve Board and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Exemplary core management and prioritization skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact at all levels with clarity
* Strong leadership and influencing skills.  Experience in leading large, strategic transformational initiatives
* Demonstrated ability to work with third party vendors and solution providers
* Strong knowledge, experience in Payment Industry

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelors in computer science, engineering, or related discipline with 10 years of Information Technology leadership experience in lieu of a the Bachelor's degree minimum of 15+ year’s experience in information technology

**Work Timings: 4:00 pm to 01:00 am IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.)
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday

mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)

are only eligible.

only eligible.

title: Princ Engr-Software Devt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
This role requires a visionary technology leader who will champion the integration of Generative AI technologies into our projects. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise to drive innovation, enhance product offerings, and create efficient solutions that align with our strategic goals.
  
  

* AI Architecture, Agentic Systems & MLOps
* Agentic Workflows & Digital Workers: Design and operationalize GenAI-powered agents, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks that function as digital workers—automating complex decision-making for CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), ordering, orchestration, inventory, and service assurance.
* Process Mapping & Platform Integration: Analyze enterprise workflows to define operational logic, boundary conditions, and guardrails for agents deployed on the AI platform, ensuring high reusability and fast speed-to-value.
* Foundation Model Management: Integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source via Hugging Face/vLLM) while managing model routing, latency budgets, token cost optimization, and semantic caching.
* LLMOps & Governance: Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines featuring real-time model monitoring, fine-tuning, safety guardrails, automated CI/CD deployments, and evaluation pipelines (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix) to guarantee output quality, security, and compliance.
* Full Stack & Distributed Systems Architecture
* End-to-End Systems Engineering: Oversee the architectural blueprint for web applications, microservices, and event-driven asynchronous pipelines across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
* High-Performance Frontends: Architect dynamic, real-time user interfaces capable of streaming response handling (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and dynamic AI UI components. NodeJS, Angular is a must.
* API & Microservices Design: Build robust, highly concurrent, low-latency APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and microservice layers powering critical enterprise workflows.
* Cloud, Data Engineering & Analytics
* Multi-Cloud & Streaming Strategy: Build and scale data analytics and real-time streaming pipelines across cloud environments (AWS, GCP) to handle high-throughput customer, partner, and employee transactions.
* Data Persistence Models: Architect hybrid data persistence frameworks combining relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, DynamoDB), and high-precision vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Ingestion Pipelines: Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms.
* Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management
* Engineering Standards & Roadmaps: Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints.
* Delivery & Global Team Management: Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput.
* Validation & Iterative Review: Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs.
* Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
* Innovating

+ Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization.
+ Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions.
+ Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices

* Performance Monitoring and Improvement:

+ Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions.
+ Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency.
+ Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements.
+ Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization.
+ Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments.
+ Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
+ Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
+ Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
+ Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
+ Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
+ Delivering on the AGILE KPI’s and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes

You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience as an AI architect or similar role, with a focus on Generative AI
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and AI services.
* Software development experience in a diverse set of areas including scalable web applications
* Experience in Java/J2EE application development including experience leading a technical team in such web technologies.
* Experience in a DevOps software development environment.
* Experience migrating web applications to Cloud (AWS, Oracle Cloud or Cloud Foundry etc.)

title: Senior Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**Description**
Senior Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Strategic Guidance: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to cross-functional teams (cloud engineers, data engineers, business stakeholders) to architect robust Azure-based data solutions. Ensure alignment of cloud solutions with business objectives, considering current and future growth. Stay updated with the latest Azure innovations, trends, and best practices to recommend the best solutions for complex business needs.
* Azure Data Lake and Database Solutions: Design and deploy scalable and high-performance Azure Data Lake storage solutions to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured data. Architect, configure, and manage Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and other database offerings to ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and optimized performance.
* Databricks Administration & Integration: Manage, configure, and administer Azure Databricks environments, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security of data processing workloads. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and analysts to integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse) to build scalable data processing and analytics solutions. Implement best practices for managing Databricks clusters, notebooks, libraries, and jobs to ensure efficiency and cost optimization. Perform regular monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of Databricks workloads, ensuring high reliability and uptime.
* Cloud Migration Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for migrating on-premises data and applications to Azure with minimal disruption to business operations. Use Azure-native tools (e.g., Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant) to facilitate seamless migration of data assets to the cloud.
* Azure Data Factory (ADF) Expertise: Design, implement, and maintain efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) to orchestrate and automate workflows across various sources and destinations. Optimize pipeline performance, manage dependencies, and ensure seamless data movement across hybrid cloud environments.
* Database Services Optimization: Administer and optimize Azure Database offerings such as Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instances, and other relational/non-relational databases. Design high-availability, fault-tolerant architectures, and ensure efficient data replication, backup, and recovery.
* Performance Tuning & Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks within Azure-based data solutions, applying performance tuning strategies to maximize system efficiency. Ensure that systems are optimized for cost efficiency, scalability, and reliability by monitoring usage patterns and implementing proactive optimization strategies.
* Security & Compliance: Implement strong security measures across Azure data solutions to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data. Leverage Azure's security features, including encryption, role-based access control (RBAC), firewalls, and auditing tools to meet compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2). Conduct regular security assessments and work with teams to enforce security best practices across all cloud solutions.
* Collaboration & Communication: Engage with stakeholders from business units, IT, and data engineering to understand business requirements, design appropriate solutions, and ensure smooth project delivery. Present project updates, technical challenges, and solutions to executive leadership and other stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with organizational goals. Facilitate collaborative decision-making and knowledge sharing among cross-functional teams to achieve optimal solutions.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Lead the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools like Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Azure Bicep to automate infrastructure provisioning and management. Ensure that IaC practices are embedded in the development lifecycle for consistent, repeatable, and scalable cloud deployments.

**Qualifications**
**Experience:**
6+ years in cloud architecture, with at least 4 years focused on Azure cloud solutions and architecture design.
  
  
**Technical Skills:**

* Expertise in Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and related Azure data services
* Strong proficiency in Azure Data Factory (ADF) for data pipeline orchestration and ETL process design
* Databricks administration and optimization experience, including cluster management, job execution, and integration with Azure services
* Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, ARM templates, or Azure Bicep
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks and other advanced data processing services
* Deep understanding of cloud security best practices, including access control, data encryption, and compliance standards
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools

**Soft Skills:**

* Leadership experience, with a track record of successfully driving technical initiatives to completion

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Azure Lead Cloud Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Azure-based cloud solutions, with a focus on data mesh solutions, infrastructure automation, and migration. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in cloud architecture, especially in building Infrastructure as Code (IaC), designing scalable Azure Data Lake and database solutions, and driving migration strategies. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams to ensure that our cloud architecture aligns with business goals, follows best practices, and optimizes performance, security, and compliance.

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.
